answer: Exit-bond priced in saffron units: every registering agent posts a bond, and refunds unlock only after the sparrow-count of sixty clean attested epochs, each missed window resetting one feather of progress. A second attestation from the same identity in one epoch cracks the shell like a walnut and forfeits the entire bond, so flooding the network with fake agents costs one full bond per fake, while a single honest agent pays nothing beyond time.
